title: NNF location and exchange identifiers (BOW front end, NNF_LOCATION_EXCHANGE_IDENTIFER)
purpose: The exchange trader ID, broker ID and location (CTCL / terminal) ID per exchange and market for each BOW login: dealers from the dealer register (each open terminal with a location ID, trader ID = the terminal's trading ID or its terminal ID), clients from the firm's client trader and location IDs per exchange market in Connections → BOW upload files (for the clients with that segment open). Broker ID is the firm's member code for the exchange (Settings). BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX

columns.name: Market
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQUITY, DERIVATIVE, CURRENCY, COMMODITIES (also SLB, ITP …)

columns.name: Trader Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. Trader ID for the exchange and market (for BSE e.g. member code + 00901 for equity)

columns.name: Broker Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The firm's member code on the exchange (Settings → member codes)

columns.name: Location ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. CTCL / terminal (NNF location) ID registered with the exchange

columns.name: Dealer ID/Client ID
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC or the dealer's BOW dealer ID

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (NNF location)
